messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — NebulaLift is scheduled for dedicated capacity bring-up next Thu 09:00 PST. We need quota numbers, autoscale policy checks, and a full surge load test. Who can lead the runbook and test orchestration?

aj_ops: I can own the runbook and ops coordination. Need target QPS, p95 SLO, and an acceptance checklist from CS. @zack_engineering can you confirm warm-cache/priming approach?

zack_engineering: Got it. Plan: staged ramp (smoke -> slow ramp -> surge). Suggested profile: 0 -> 100 -> 500 -> 2000 qps over ~45m with 5m holds. Warm-up script seeds KV/prefix caches and token-prime with short prompts. Sharing quick k6 command:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m loadscript.js
```
Will add a canary run against the dev pool first.

sylvia_cust_eng: FYI NebulaLift called out p95 < 1s for 128-token prompts as a renewal bar in their QBR. If we miss, renewal conversation becomes tricky — want frequent status updates during testing.

kevin_product: Recommend enabling prefix KV caching + 16-bit quantized model variant for the surge to keep cost in check. Model tag we will expose: `nlp-v2-quant`. Add that to runbook as a toggle.

capacity-bot: pool-create finished: pool-id=nebula-prod-1, gpus=8, region=us-west-2, created_by=aj_ops

aj_ops: Draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nebula-lift (private). Timeline: Tue 15:00 smoke tests (low qps), Wed 10:00 priming window (cache/token warm), Thu 09:00 full surge + chaos step. Rollback plan included. Need CS to confirm calendar invites and customer-facing comms. :calendar:

maria_cs: I'll send invites and a single status doc for the customer. Also capturing enablement items: API key scopes, sample SDK snippet, and load-test report template.

zack_engineering: Adding a chaos step to the surge: simulate one GPU loss at 30% into the peak to validate fallback routing to hosted variants. Command we'll run during the test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/traffic-shift -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS' -d '{"from_pool":"nebula-prod-1","to_pool":"hosted-fallback","percent":50}'
```
Monitor metrics: p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost, GPU utilization, queue length. Alert thresholds: p95 > 1.2s or error-rate > 1% triggers immediate rollback.

sylvia_cust_eng: Noted. I'll prepare the renewal-risk note and vendor comms if we hit degradation. Also will collect post-test feedback using the standard CS template.

aj_ops: Ops checklist highlights: quota bump verified in IAM, autoscale policy set to min=2 max=8, batching config pinned for 128-token baseline, KV cache priming script uploaded to /ops/loadtests/nebula.

maria_cs: Thanks — please add a short feedback capture step for the customer: 3 quick questions after surge (latency, errors, perceived slowness). I'll attach to the postmortem doc. :memo:

zack_engineering: One more: instrument a sampling of model outputs for regression checks (10k tokens sample) and wire it to the evals dashboard so product/ML can review before we sign off.

kevin_product: We'll stand by to review samples. If we need a quantization rollback, flag me asap.

maria_cs: Great work. Final action items: aj_ops sends runbook + invites today, zack runs canary Tue, sylvia preps renewal note, kevin on standby. I'll send final checklist by EOD. :checkered_flag:
